svg.aria-label: ACE V2 in one picture: public data and open models on weather, floods, land and soil, markets, health and language flow into ACE, which fetches on a schedule, keeps dated licensed snapshots, runs the safety rail first, applies a published decision rule and returns a short cited answer to farmers, expectant mothers, community health workers, traders, extension officers and developers on any phone.
